grammar.scope: v0 combines one geometry primitive with one coupling-reader kernel; longer algebraic words remain a later gate

reduction.interpretation: constant displacement is invisible to translation-invariant projection; slope-magnitude projection cannot distinguish bowl from saddle sign structure

admission.rule: retire or merge aliases before real-data fitting; add a reader only when it separates a preregistered equivalence class
admission.displacement: requires an absolute, distance-sensitive or signed reader
admission.twist: requires a loop or parallel-transport reader
admission.reason: synthetic distinguishability demonstrates instrumentation logic, not physical occurrence

nextGate: add typed coupling as a separate algebraic layer, canonicalize low-word-length compositions, add nuisance generators and require inject-recover plus confusion tests before real-data admission
